pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.subtitle: The steps a task runs through, who does each one and where it waits for you. Runs keep the version they started with.
pipelines.emptyDetail: Create a pipeline to choose the steps your tasks run through.
pipelines.draftHint: Your edits are saved as a draft. Runs don't use them yet.
pipelines.publishHint: Publish when ready. New runs use this version.
pipelines.pinnedHint: A run keeps the version it started with.
pipelines.name: Name
pipelines.startHint: Pick how draft v1 begins. Every step can be changed afterwards.
pipelines.copyHint: Its published version becomes draft v1.
pipelines.emptyHint: Start from ON TASK START and add steps on the canvas.
pipelines.slugHint: Generated from the name. Fixed after the first publish.
pipelines.createHint: Create draft v1 saves it. Tasks can use it once you publish it.
pipelines.publishedHint: Published v{{version}} · your next edit starts a new draft
pipelines.runHint: Create a task to run this pipeline.
pipelines.emptyStepsHint: Choose what runs, then connect the steps in the order they should finish.
pipelines.toolBadge: Its exit code decides the step
pipelines.askTools: Ask when a tool needs approval
pipelines.narrowHint: Steps can only narrow profile permissions.
pipelines.narrowUnavailable: Only choices the profile and its connection enforce on this platform can be changed.
pipelines.toolUnavailable: This tool cannot run as a pipeline step in this version.
pipelines.removeHint: Steps after it will follow its dependencies. Failure routes may need updating.
pipelines.leaveHint: Keep editing, or leave this page. Unsaved changes will be discarded.
pipelines.error: The pipeline could not be saved
pipelines.conflict: The saved pipeline changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving; your unsaved changes will be replaced.
pipelines.reviewHint: New runs start on this version. Nothing already started changes.
pipelines.settingsHint: Changes save to the draft and reach new runs when you publish.
pipelines.proposal: These settings are planned and are not available in this version.
pipelines.fixedFailure: A step that stops without a result restarts once, then waits for your decision.
pipelines.presets: Project presets can be added later. These starting points are built in.
pipelines.collision: This name generates a slug already used in this project.
pipelines.notPublishedHint: Publish a version before using this pipeline in a task.
pipelines.nameRequired: Name the pipeline to create it
pipelines.starterUnavailable: Choose Starter when creating a new pipeline.
pipelines.draftStrip: Changed in draft · New runs get these changes after you publish.
pipelines.descriptionHelp: What this pipeline is for. Shown in the library and when choosing a pipeline.
pipelines.nameHelp: The name shown throughout this project.
pipelines.slugHelp: Used in references. Fixed after the first publish.
pipelines.startsHelp: When a task's run begins, it enters the pipeline here.
pipelines.onStartHelp: Starts when you run a task with this pipeline.
